prs.status: pending after two fixture failures on previous head
prs.note: Main 19496654 remains integrated; current head is d012a301. [New CI](https://github.com/eloqdata/lavik/actions/runs/37243651484) is pending. The prior d5ca3a1b run exposed two fixture failures: native FULL-tail collection assertions raced initialization-to-Follow-Owner ingress replacement and received LOADING; Sentinel HA checked independent clients serially under one shared 30-second budget. The first fix waits for all source flows to CONTINUE and a fresh live-flow/known-seed readiness probe before one-shot collection assertions, retaining exactly one original FULL per source worker. The second reuses the reviewed concurrent-probe fix from #271 without extending the deadline. Formatting/diff checks pass. The Sentinel helper’s four unit tests passed at the original shared fix revision; no local integration run or native performance claim is made for this new head while Stream controls run.
